<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that, in the forward direction, break an aromatic carboxylic acid and form a C‑C double bond, which matches the Doebner modification producing cinnamic acid (O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1). Use the correct functional group names from the available list.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
